184	# ============ 归一化工具 ============
185	def minmax_normalize(values):
186	    """将列表线性映射到 0~1"""
187	    mn, mx = min(values), max(values)
188	    if mx == mn:
189	        return [0.5] * len(values)

194	    n = len(heroes_sorted_by_score)
195	    result = {}
